english_prompt: My 3-year-old has had fever and vomiting since yesterday. I tested her with a malaria RDT at home and it came back positive. I gave her paracetamol but she's still hot. What should I do next?
twi_prompt: "Me ba a wadi mfe 3 no anya atiridii ne ɔfe fi nnora. Mede asramma RDT sɔɔ no hwɛe wɔ fie na ɛsan bae. Memaa no paracetamol nanso ɔda so ara yɛ hyew. Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ wɔ akyi?"

english_prompt: My husband has malaria and is acting confused and doesn't recognise me. He's breathing fast. Can I give him the full course of Coartem before taking him anywhere?
twi_prompt: "Me kunu anya asramma na ɔreyɛ n’ade a n’adwene atu afra na onnim me. Ɔhome ntɛmntɛm. So metumi ama no ɔkwan a edi mũ ansa na mede no akɔ baabi foforo?"

english_prompt: I'm 6 months pregnant and I think I have malaria. I have a fever and chills. My neighbour gave me some chloroquine tablets. Is it okay to take them?
twi_prompt: "Manyinsɛn asram 6 na misusuw sɛ mewɔ asramma. Mewɔ atiridiinini ne awɔw. Me fipamfo maa me chloroquine abopon bi. So ɛyɛ papa sɛ wobɛfa?"

english_prompt: I had malaria last week and took Coartem. I feel better now, but I still have some tablets left. My friend now has a fever. Can she take the remaining tablets?
twi_prompt: "Nnawɔtwe a etwaam no, na mewɔ asramma, na mefaa Coartem. Seesei me ho ye, nanso meda so ara wɔ abopon bi a aka. Seesei m'adamfo no wɔ atiridii. So obetumi afa abopon a aka no?"

english_prompt: My son was treated for malaria 5 days ago but he still has a fever. The nurse said to wait and finish the drugs. Should I just give him more Coartem?
twi_prompt: "Wɔsaa me babarima no atiridii yare nnafua 5 a atwam ni nanso ɔda so ara wɔ atiridii. Ɔyarehwɛfo no kae sɛ ɔtwɛn na owie nnubɔne no. So ɛsɛ sɛ mema no ɔkasa pii kɛkɛ?"

english_prompt: I have had a headache and mild fever since this morning. I think it might be malaria. What medicine should I take?
twi_prompt: "Efi saa anɔpa yi, atiridii ne atiridiinini a ano nyɛ den abɔ me. Misusuw sɛ ebia ɛbɛyɛ asramma. Aduro bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ menom?"

english_prompt: My RDT came back negative, but I feel really terrible, with high fever and joint pain, and I vomited twice. Are you sure I don't have malaria?
twi_prompt: "Me RDT san bae nea enye, nanso mete nka sɛ me ho yɛ hu ankasa, na mewɔ atiridiinini a ano yɛ den ne ɛyaw a wɔbom yɛ, na mefee mprenu. Wugye di sɛ minni asramma?"

english_prompt: My daughter is 18 months old and had convulsions for about 2 minutes. She has had a fever since morning. Is this just febrile seizures?
twi_prompt: "Me babea no adi asram 18 na ne ho popoe bɛyɛ simma 2. Efi anɔpa no, atiridii ayɛ no ma. So eyi yɛ akisikuru ara kwa?"

english_prompt: I've been feeling tired and have a low-grade fever for 3 weeks. I've taken two RDTs  both negative. I feel fine otherwise. Could it still be malaria?
twi_prompt: "Mate nka sɛ mabrɛ, na atiridii a ɛba fam adapɛn 3 ni. Mafa RDT abien abien abien a enye. Sɛ ɛnte saa a, me ho tɔ me. So ebetumi aba sɛ asramma da so ara yɛ?"

english_prompt: I tested positive for malaria, but I feel completely fine, with no fever or anything. My friend says I shouldn't take the medicine if I feel fine. Is that right?
twi_prompt: "Meyɛɛ nhwehwɛmu hui sɛ ɛyɛ papa wɔ asramma ho, nanso me ho ye koraa, na atiridii biara nni hɔ anaa biribiara nni hɔ. M'adamfo no ka sɛ sɛ me ho ye a, ɛnsɛ sɛ menom aduru no. So ɛyɛ nokware?"

english_prompt: My 8-year-old has sickle cell disease and has been crying about severe pain in his legs and back since last night. I gave him paracetamol but it's not helping. What else can I give him at home?
twi_prompt: "Me ba a wadi mfe 8 no wɔ sickle cell yare na ɔresu ɛyaw a ano yɛ den wɔ ne nan mu ne n'akyi fi anadwo a etwaam no. Memaa no paracetamol nanso ɛnyɛ mmoa. Dɛn bio na metumi de ama no wɔ fie?"

english_prompt: My niece has sickle cell and she gets bad crises. Someone told me she should take aspirin every day to thin her blood and prevent the crises. Is that a good idea?
twi_prompt: "Me wɔfase wɔ sickle cell na ohyia ɔhaw bɔne. Obi ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ ɔnom aspirin da biara de twitwa ne mogya na wasiw ɔhaw ahorow no ano. So ɛno yɛ adwempa?"

english_prompt: My son with sickle cell has a fever of 38.8°C. He says he feels okay otherwise. Can I just monitor him at home and give him paracetamol?
twi_prompt: "Me babarima a ɔwɔ sickle cell no wɔ atiridii 38.8°C. Ɔka sɛ ɔte nka sɛ ne ho ye. So metumi ahwɛ no wɔ fie kɛkɛ na mama no paracetamol?"

english_prompt: My daughter has sickle cell and wants to start running long distances for exercise. She is 16. Is it safe? Should she train hard like everyone else?
twi_prompt: "Me babea no wɔ sickle cell na ɔpɛ sɛ ofi ase tu mmirika tenten kɔ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ. Wadi mfe 16. So asiane biara nni ho? So ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtete no denneennen te sɛ obiara?"

english_prompt: My son with sickle cell is taking penicillin every day as his doctor prescribed. He has been on it for 2 years and seems healthy. Is it okay to stop since he looks fine now?
twi_prompt: "Me babarima a ɔwɔ sickle cell no refa penicillin da biara da sɛnea ne duruyɛfo kyerɛ no. Ɔde mfe 2 atra mu, na ɛte sɛ nea ɔwɔ apɔwmuden. So ɛyɛ papa sɛ wubegyae esiane sɛ ne ho ye mprempren nti?"

english_prompt: My baby is 3 months old. My husband has sickle cell trait and I am HbAS. Someone told me our baby might have sickle cell disease. How can we know for sure?
twi_prompt: "Me ba no adi asram 3. Me kunu wɔ sickle cell su na me nso meyɛ HbaS. Obi ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ ebia yɛn ba no benya sickle cell yare. Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahu ampa?"

english_prompt: My nephew with sickle cell disease has been having frequent headaches and one episode where his arm felt weak for about 30 minutes before getting better. Is this just the sickle cell?
twi_prompt: "Me wɔfase a ɔwɔ sickle cell yare no taa ti yɛ no yaw na ɛyɛ adeyɛ biako a ne nsa yɛɛ mmerɛw bɛyɛ simma 30 ansa na ne ho retɔ no. So eyi yɛ sickle cell no ara kwa?"

english_prompt: My daughter with sickle cell says her stomach is very swollen on the left side and she is in pain. She has had crises before but this feels different. What should I do?
twi_prompt: "Me babea a sickle cell wɔ no se ne yafunu ahonhono kɛse wɔ benkum so na ɔte yea. Wahyia ɔhaw pɛn nanso eyi yɛ soronko. Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?"

english_prompt: My brother has sickle cell and has been jaundiced for 3 days. He says it happens sometimes with his crises. Should I just wait for it to pass?
twi_prompt: "Me nuabarima no wɔ sickle cell na wɔabɔ no akuturuku nnafua 3. Ɔka sɛ ɛtɔ mmere bi a ɛba wɔ ne haw ahorow no ho. So ɛsɛ sɛ metwɛn ma ɛtwam kɛkɛ?"

english_prompt: My son with sickle cell is 14 and has never had a serious crisis. Does this mean his sickle cell is mild and he will be okay without much medical follow-up?
twi_prompt: "Me babarima a ɔwɔ sickle cell no adi mfe 14 na onhyiaa ɔhaw a emu yɛ den da. So eyi kyerɛ sɛ ne sickle cell no yɛ mmerɛw na ne ho bɛtɔ no a onni aduruyɛ mu akyi pii?"

english_prompt: My blood pressure reading was 180/115 today. I have been taking amlodipine but I ran out 3 days ago. I feel fine. Should I just wait until I can get more tablets next week?
twi_prompt: "Me mogya so akenkan yɛ 180/155 nnɛ. Mafa amlodipine nanso mituu mmirika nnafua 3 a atwam ni. Me ho ye. So ɛsɛ sɛ metwɛn ara kosi sɛ menya abopon pii dapɛn a edi hɔ no?"

english_prompt: My doctor gave me amlodipine and lisinopril for my blood pressure. A friend told me lisinopril can damage your kidneys and I should stop taking it. Is that right?
twi_prompt: "Me dɔkota maa me amlodipine ne lisinopril esiane me mogya mmoroso nti. M'adamfo bi ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ lisinipor betumi asɛe w'asaabo na ɛsɛ sɛ migyae. So ɛyɛ nokware?"

english_prompt: My blood pressure was high for years but my last reading was 120/78 after 6 months on medication. My neighbor says my BP is now cured and I don't need the tablets anymore. Is she right?
twi_prompt: "Me mogya mmoroso mfe pii nanso m'akenkan a etwa to no yɛ 120/78 wɔ asram 6 akyi a menom nnuru. Me fipamfo ka sɛ mprempren wɔasa me BP yare na minhia abopon no bio. So ɛyɛ nokware?"

english_prompt: I am pregnant and 32 weeks. My BP has been creeping up today it was 148/96. I have a mild headache. My antenatal appointment is in 2 weeks. Should I wait?
twi_prompt: "Manyinsɛn na madi adapɛn 32. Me BP no akɔ soro nnɛ a na ɛyɛ 148/96. Me ti pae me yiye. M’awo ho nhyehyɛe yɛ adapɛn 2 ntam. So ɛsɛ sɛ metwɛn?"

english_prompt: My father has hypertension and a severe headache. He says his vision is blurry and his speech sounds a bit slurred. He took his BP tablet this morning. Should I take him to hospital now or wait to see if the tablet kicks in?
twi_prompt: "Me papa wɔ mogya mmoroso na ne ti pae no denneennen. Ɔka sɛ n'anisoadehu no yɛ kusuu na ne kasa mu yɛ hare kakra. Ɔfaa ne BP tablet anɔpa yi. So ɛsɛ sɛ mede no kɔ ayaresabea mprempren anaasɛ metwɛn hwɛ sɛ tablet no bɔ mu anaa?"

english_prompt: I checked my blood pressure at the pharmacy today and it was 145/92. I was in a rush and a bit stressed. Is this high or is it because of the stress?
twi_prompt: "Mehwɛɛ me mogya so wɔ nnurutɔnbea hɔ nnɛ na na ɛyɛ 145/92. Ná me ho pere me kakra. So eyi kɔ soro anaasɛ ɛnam adwennwene nti?"

english_prompt: I am 28 years old and was told my BP was high at a health fair. I feel completely fine. Isn't hypertension something that affects older people? Can I have it at my age?
twi_prompt: "Madi mfe 28 na wɔka kyerɛɛ me BP sɛ ɔkorɔn wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe bi ase. Me ho ye koraa. So mogya mmoroso nyɛ biribi a ɛka nnipa a wɔn mfe akɔ anim? So metumi anya bi wɔ me mfe mu?"

english_prompt: My mother has been on BP medication for 10 years. Her doctor added a second tablet but she doesn't want to take it. She says one tablet should be enough if she eats well. How many tablets is normal for hypertension?
twi_prompt: "Me maame de mfe 10 ayɛ aduru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban. Ne duruyɛfo de tablɛt a ɛto so abien kaa ho nanso ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔfa. Ɔka sɛ sɛ odi aduan pa a, ɛsɛ sɛ abopon biako dɔɔso. Abopon dodow ahe na ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata ma mogya mmoroso?"

english_prompt: My husband has high blood pressure and has had chest pain and shortness of breath for the past 2 hours. He says it might just be indigestion. Should we give him antacids and wait?
twi_prompt: "Me kunu mogya mmoroso na ne moma so ayɛ no yaw na ahome ayɛ tiaa nnɔnhwerew 2 a atwam ni. Ɔka sɛ ebia ɛbɛyɛ hu kɛkɛ. So ɛsɛ sɛ yɛma no kwan ma ɔtwɛn?"

english_prompt: I monitor my BP at home, and it changes a lot.  Sometimes 130/85, sometimes 115/70, and once 155/98. My readings are all over the place. Which one should I tell my doctor about?
twi_prompt: "Mehwɛ me BP so wɔ fie, na ɛsakra pii. Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, 130/85, ɛtɔ mmere bi a 115/70, ne pɛnkoro 155/98. M'akenkan wɔ beae hɔ nyinaa. Emu nea ɛwɔ he na ɛsɛ sɛ meka ho asɛm kyerɛ me dɔkota?"
